gloss: to deduct; to subtract; to balance

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{引|ひ}きませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{引|ひ}いていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {差|さ}し{引|ひ}いていませんでした

definitions.explanation: To remove an amount from a total, typically in financial or mathematical contexts.
To consider both positive and negative factors and arrive at a net result.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く。
⟦{経費|けいひ}→経費：04696_keihi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}くと⟦{利益|りえき}→利益：03673_rieki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ほとんど→ほとんど：00847_hotondo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: After deducting expenses, there's almost no profit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{税金|ぜいきん}→税金：03308_zeikin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いた⟦{手取|てど}り→手取り：06833_tedori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧20⟦{万円|まんえん}→万円：09900_manen⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The take-home pay after deducting taxes is 200,000 yen.

examples.japanese: {差|さ}し{引|ひ}き⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。

⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{悪|わる}い→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦ところ→所：01137_tokoro⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}いて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧と、⟦{悪|わる}くない→悪い：00908_warui⟧⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Balancing the good and the bad, it's not a bad deal.

examples.japanese: ⟦{苦労|くろう}→苦労：02672_kurou⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{多|おお}かった→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{差|さ}し{引|ひ}き⟦すれば→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{楽|たの}しい→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There were many hardships, but on balance it was an enjoyable experience.

notes:
FORMATION:
Compound verb: ⟦{差|さ}す→差す：17637_sasu⟧ (to insert) + ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧ (to pull, to subtract)

USAGE:
・Sense 1 is arithmetic on a stated total: the amount removed takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧, and what remains is usually named with {差|さ}し{引|ひ}いた + noun (example 3).
・Sense 2 weighs pluses against minuses rather than money, and most often appears as the noun {差|さ}し{引|ひ}き or as {差|さ}し{引|ひ}いて⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧ (to take everything into account).
・Everyday subtraction is plain ⟦{引|ひ}く→引く：01978_hiku⟧; {差|さ}し{引|ひ}く implies deducting from a sum owed or earned, so it belongs to payroll, invoicing, and accounting language.

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{差|さ}し{引|ひ}き - noun form meaning "deduction" or "balance"
・{差|さ}し{引|ひ}き⟦{勘定|かんじょう}→勘定：02582_kanjou⟧ - net calculation/balance
・{差|さ}し{引|ひ}き⟦ゼロ→ゼロ：01011_zero⟧ - balances out to zero
・⟦{源泉徴収|げんせんちょうしゅう}→源泉徴収：04908_gensenchoushuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く (to deduct withholding tax)
・⟦{割引|わりびき}→割引：01526_waribiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{差|さ}し{引|ひ}く (to deduct a discount)
